payload.prompt: Tower of London on the Thames in a premodern royal fortress city, white keep, curtain walls, river gate, jewel guards, prisoners' towers, royal armour, soldiers and officials, historically grounded world wonder key art, cinematic riverside view, ultra-detailed, no modern elements.

revised_prompt: Create key art in a 1536x1024 wide cinematic composition: the Tower of London on the River Thames in the premodern era, presented as a grand royal fortress city and world wonder. Show the iconic White Tower/white keep at the center, surrounded by massive stone curtain walls, battlements, towers for prisoners, a river gate opening to the Thames, and a busy fortified riverside. Include historically grounded medieval jewel guards, soldiers, officials, and displays of royal armour, all in authentic period clothing and equipment. Atmosphere: majestic, realistic, ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting, dramatic sky, rich textures in stone, timber, banners, armor, and water reflections. Perspective: sweeping riverside view from across the Thames, emphasizing scale and fortress complexity. Absolutely no modern elements, no anachronisms, no modern skyline, no contemporary boats, no fantasy architecture.
